[[Named item sets#Arcsteel Battlemage|Arcsteel Battlemage]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Named item sets#Arcsteel Battlemage|Arcsteel Battlemage]]:''' While wearing three items from the Arcsteel Battlemage set, you gain:
+25% Artifact bonus to Electric, Fire, Force, and Repair Spell Power
+5% Artifact bonus to Electric, Fire, Force, and Repair Spell Crit Chance
+2 Artifact bonus to Intelligence
+1 Artifact bonus to Spell DCs.
